comparison_rule: Source/PDF literal comparison may remove whitespace only. Any remaining difference is explicitly reviewed; no case/date/unit/number repair or inferred text is inserted.
declaration_timing: Before any v18 actual-raster inspection; exact source populations and inherited renderer are already frozen and independently read back.
public_boundary: Only counts, locators, anchors, categorical checks/decisions and artifact digests are public. Raw source/CSS, values and literal comparison observations remain external.
required_per_block_checks: Original source hash, complete original DOM node and exact byte span; no fragment rewrite or omission.
Complete original ancestor opening tags and source head styles retained in assembly; ancestor siblings are not imported.
Saved compatibility ledger replays derived input, preserves every nonpatch byte, and final UTF8 metadata addition is separately bound.
Source CSS dependency/hiding/position/opacity/overflow and retained-border risks checked explicitly.
Every available raster page actually inspected for complete readable glyphs, clipping, overlap and material label/header/cell/grouping ambiguity.
Table/whole-row source span and cell/label sequence checked; original zero-fact heading-row/definition-table status retained.
Failed, unavailable, unreadable or materially ambiguous views excluded while preserving every requested block.
retained_limitations: Authored low-alpha border-opacity fidelity failed and remains unsupported. Any material border-induced grouping, label or column ambiguity excludes that view.
Full browser/CSS fidelity, font identity and original full-page geometry are not certified.
Document adjacency, inventory role and linked bundle IDs do not verify semantic attachment, period/unit/entity/population scope or complete evidence.
The separately rendered NVDAform recovery does not relabel its original failed v17attempt or automatically admit an identity card.
role_statement: Agents inspect disjoint source subsets; no duplicate annotation or inter-annotator agreement claim.
